dossier.identity: sonic-resonance operator who keeps a squad in rhythm: restorative waves, haste fields laid by a white sea duck and a cadence that hastens allies on every third cast
dossier.selectionRationale: chosen as the tempo operator: heals and cleanses in a cone like nyra but trades emergency saves for haste fields and cooldown rate, separate from fable's overflow barriers and lyra's speaker. the sheet's "waveform rifle" and "cloudstep" haste field set the role; recorded as operator (the sheet's own role label).
dossier.weaponConcept: waveform rifle (sonic resonance rifle with dual ring emitters, a wave-guide chord matrix, a synthetic-gel coolant reservoir, a phase stabilizer and a modular quick-swap frame)

lore.backstory: former harbour-signal technician from the flooded lower docks who tuned the sea-duck decoy beacons that guided convoys through fog. when the beacons were switched off to save a subscription fee she fused their ring emitters into a rifle and kept the white duck that nested in the array. now she walks the ruined quays letting a clean signal carry people home.
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for rebroadcasting a corporate evacuation order on every open frequency and for refusing to return seven licensed beacon arrays.
lore.psychProfile: patient, soft-spoken and impossible to rattle; treats a firefight like a rehearsal that just needs a steadier tempo.
lore.combatQuote: “clearer signals bring us closer. keep the beat and i will keep you moving.”

forms.description: Calls a white sea duck (carrier: 220 hp, shootable) down to a point up to 8 m (800 cm) away: radius 3 m (300 cm), lasts 5 s (150 ticks), pulses every 1 s (30 ticks) and grants allies inside 20% haste for 1.5 s. Cost 38 · windup 0.6 s (18 ticks) · cooldown 18 s (540 ticks).

forms.name: down cushion
forms.description: The duck's first pulse also wraps allies inside in a 70 barrier for 4 s (120 ticks).

forms.name: twin flock
forms.description: A second duck lands beside the first (count 2): each is a 3 m (300 cm) haste field, haste rises to 30% and lingers 2 s (60 ticks) after an ally leaves, and a shot-down duck bursts for 60 healing.

iconFamily.subject: a bold sea duck riding a single chunky sound wave
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Eider. Theme: soft static. Subject: a bold sea duck riding a single chunky sound wave. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
